scope: The standing 1908 Masonic lodge at 13 Hawthorn Street in Blackall, Queensland. The reconstruction covers the two-storey rectangular hall, the corrugated roof, the Hawthorn Street veranda and its steep entrance gable, and stepped rear access.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Register item 600032 identifies the west-facing raised, two-storey timber hall, corrugated roof, posts, and central veranda gable.
The former lodge confirms the historic building, its address and much of the surviving fabric.
The new operator identifies the Lodge on Hawthorn venue in the historic Masonic temple bought in 2016.
